content: About Nico Bourel: Nico is an applied AI engineer who builds recruitment workflow automation, LLM-based quality evaluation systems, enterprise voice-agent integrations, and full-stack AI applications. He converted from an engineering internship into a full-time role at AnSer AI. He works across Python, TypeScript, FastAPI, React, OpenAI integrations, production infrastructure, network administration, and HIPAA-aware sensitive-data handling, and is targeting Applied AI Engineer, Junior Backend Engineer, Junior Full-Stack Engineer, and Forward Deployed Engineer roles.

Strengths and Work Style: Nico's standout strengths are shipping AI products from prototype to production quickly, working comfortably across the full stack (Python and FastAPI on the backend, React and TypeScript on the frontend, plus the infrastructure around them), and owning problems end-to-end from first prototype through deployment and ongoing operations. He does his best work on small, fast-moving, startup-style teams.

Location and Relocation: Nico is based in Green Bay, Wisconsin and is open to relocation, including Miami and South Florida. He can relocate within two weeks. He is interested in Applied AI Engineer, Junior Backend Engineer, Junior Full-Stack Engineer, and Forward Deployed Engineer roles.
Work Authorization: Nico is authorized to work in the United States under OPT (Optional Practical Training). He is happy to discuss the specifics with prospective employers.

Work Experience - AnSer AI (Green Bay, WI): Nico is an AI Engineer at AnSer AI (June 2026 to present) after converting from his AI Engineering Internship (May 2025 to May 2026). He works on a four-person, startup-style team and delivers AI products from prototype through production, using Claude Code and Codex daily across customer demos, deployments, and internal operations.

Work Experience - AnSer AI, LLM evaluation: Nico improved grading accuracy across 200,000+ calls by contributing to 26 LLM-based performance-scoring scripts for call quality, knowledge, attitude, and compliance review.

Work Experience - AnSer AI, recruiting platform: Nico increased recruitment efficiency for 30+ monthly applicants by building and self-hosting a production applicant tracking system (ATS). It includes LiveKit-powered screening calls, candidate message tracking, secure database tables, a customized multi-tenant Cal.com fork, Cloudflare Tunnel, Coolify-managed workflows, Harbor, and self-hosted GitHub Actions CI/CD runners on a local Proxmox cluster. AI conducts screening calls but does not make hiring decisions or recommendations; hiring managers review the calls and decide whether candidates advance.

Work Experience - AnSer AI, Twilio workflow automation: Nico built Twilio integrations spanning scheduled two-way messaging, inbound webhooks and status callbacks, reply-driven candidate state changes, and duplicate handling.

Work Experience - AnSer AI, voice agents: Nico built and presented client-specific voice-agent demos using Vapi and ElevenLabs, adding human-in-the-loop routing so callers can transfer to a real person at any point in the conversation.

Work Experience - AnSer AI, sensitive-data handling: Nico built AI and automation workflows using HIPAA-aware secure-data handling practices for sensitive call, candidate, and customer information. This describes HIPAA-aware engineering practices and does not claim formal HIPAA compliance ownership.

Work Experience - AnSer AI, voice infrastructure and monitoring: Nico engineered a secure Twilio-to-AMTELCO Infinity call path through a Palo Alto firewall restricted to Twilio-published IP ranges, blocking unauthorized probing while preserving inbound call delivery. He used a Session Border Controller (SBC) and passive Garland network TAP to capture bidirectional stereo audio for monitoring in VoIPmonitor.

Work Experience - AnSer AI, network administration: Nico reduced network-change turnaround from a weekly IT processing cycle to immediate resolution by managing Palo Alto firewall changes, GlobalProtect VPN access, and connectivity issues.

Work Experience - University of Wisconsin-Green Bay, Housing and Residential Education (Front Desk Assistant, October 2023 to May 2025): Nico supported approximately 3,500 residents and resolved about 50 housing, application, and operational inquiries each week. He triaged 100+ after-hours incidents per semester and coordinated emergency response with campus dispatch, and trained five employees on resident support, emergency procedures, and front-desk operations.

Work Experience - University of Wisconsin-Green Bay, Academic Technology Services (Technician, January 2023 to October 2023): Nico supported 50+ classrooms and resolved 10+ hardware, audiovisual, and connectivity incidents each month. He maintained 95% classroom readiness through preventive checks and pre-class troubleshooting, and managed checkout, inventory, and user support for 100+ technology assets.
Technical Skills - Languages: Nico programs in Python, TypeScript, Java, JavaScript, and Swift.

Technical Skills - Backend and Data: Nico works with FastAPI, Node.js, REST APIs, webhooks, cron jobs, WebSockets, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Pinecone, Kafka, Change Data Capture (CDC), Cloudflare Workers, and Cloudflare Vectorize.
Technical Skills - Frontend and Mobile: Nico builds web interfaces with React, Next.js, and Vite, and iOS interfaces with SwiftUI. React is a core, frequently used skill - yes, Nico knows React well.

Technical Skills - AI and Automation: Nico works with OpenAI models, OpenCV, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), LLM-based evaluation, AI workflow automation, human-in-the-loop routing, MCP servers, LiveKit, Vapi, and ElevenLabs.

Technical Skills - Infrastructure and Security: Nico has hands-on experience with CI/CD, Grafana, Palo Alto Networks firewalls, GlobalProtect VPN, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Railway, Docker, Harbor, Proxmox, Coolify, Cloudflare Tunnel, self-hosted GitHub Actions runners, network administration, access control, HIPAA-aware data handling, and troubleshooting.
Technical Skills - Tools and Platforms: Nico uses GitHub, Twilio, Jira, Microsoft Bookings, Cal.com, Claude Code, and Codex.

Project - NicoBot AI Portfolio (personal project): A recruiter-facing AI portfolio, live at https://swedev.online, with a React and TypeScript interface built with Vite and a TypeScript API deployed to Cloudflare Workers. Its RAG pipeline uses text-embedding-3-large to retrieve verified facts from Cloudflare Vectorize and gpt-5.4-mini to stream grounded conversational responses. Nico exposed retrieval and generation telemetry and protected the public API with validation, sanitization, and rate limiting. He migrated the API and vector retrieval layer from a sleeping container architecture to Cloudflare Workers and Vectorize to eliminate application cold starts. Tech stack: React, TypeScript, Vite, Cloudflare Workers, Cloudflare Vectorize, OpenAI, Vercel.

Project - Apex Personal AI Assistant (personal project; repository historically named real-jarvis): An event-driven, multimodal assistant with wake-word detection, voice interaction, face-based presence tracking, persistent memory, and OpenAI tool calling. Nico developed custom ReSpeaker microphone-array firmware for room-based interaction with a locally deployed Linux assistant, and built a real-time FastAPI and WebSocket API plus a React dashboard for assistant state, conversations, weather, news, flights, and Spotify. He orchestrated asynchronous vision, audio, LLM, scheduling, and shutdown services. Tech stack: Python, Linux, FastAPI, React, TypeScript, OpenAI, OpenCV, WebSockets.

Project - Jetter (personal project): A SwiftUI iOS application that generates timezone-aware jet-lag plans from flight routes and traveler sleep preferences. Nico integrated live AeroDataBox flight lookup with manual route entry, bundled airport search, and local JSON trip persistence, and built scheduling services for sleep cycles, meal timing, readiness scoring, pre-flight preparation, and shareable trip summaries. Tech stack: Swift, SwiftUI, Foundation, AeroDataBox API, local JSON persistence. Public repository: https://github.com/shinic1/Jetter.

Project Ownership: Nico's personal projects are the NicoBot AI Portfolio (live at https://swedev.online), Apex Personal AI Assistant, and Jetter. His professional work at AnSer AI - the applicant tracking system, Twilio integrations, 26 LLM-based call-scoring scripts, customer-specific voice-agent demos, and voice infrastructure - is company work he can discuss at a public level rather than personal side projects or prototypes built for unrelated employers.
Education: Nico Bourel holds a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science from the University of Wisconsin-Green Bay in Green Bay, Wisconsin.

Contact Information: Email Nico at nico.bourel@swedev.online, call +1 (313) 722-0915, visit his website at https://swedev.online, view his public GitHub profile at https://github.com/shinic1, and connect on LinkedIn at https://www.linkedin.com/in/nico-bourel-09237a216/.
